title: Technology Sector Update for 01/28/2019: COMM,VSM,ENTG,NVDA
text:

Technology stocks were falling in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing almost 1.5% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was dropping just over 2.0%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) AudioCodes ( AUDC ) extended its early gains, rising almost 10% shortly before Monday's closing bell after reporting non-GAAP Q4 net income of $0.20 per share, up from $0.12 per share during the same quarter last and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per share.
In other sector news:
(+) Versum Matierals ( VSM ) jumped out to a 15.5% gain on Monday after agreeing to a $3.83 billion merger offer from rival semiconductor supplier Entegris ( ENTG ).
(+) CommScope ( COMM ) rose almost 9% on Monday after the wireless network equipment company reported preliminary Q4 revenue in a range of $1.05 billion to $1.07 billion, exceeding the $1.04 billion Street view.
(-) NVIDIA Corp ( NVDA ) slumped 14% on Monday after the chipmaker cut it Q4 revenue forecast to a range of $2.16 billion to $2.24 billion, down $500 million from the mid-point of its prior range and lagging the $2.70 billion analyst mean.
